contentBlocks.body: Practice problem. Count how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) appear in a lowercase word. Spreading a string into an array lets you filter character by character.
Hint: "aeiou".includes(character) is true when the character is a vowel.
**Worked example.** Each character contributes either zero or one. p contributes zero, a one, p zero, e one, r zero. The accumulator represents all matches seen so far, not just the latest character.
Repeated vowels count repeatedly. A Set of found vowels would count distinct vowel types instead.

**Try a small change.** How would uppercase input change the result? Decide where normalization belongs.

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.
